phy-websocket-audit 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Scans code for 10 critical WebSocket security vulnerabilities across Node.js, Python, Go, Java, and Ruby projects.
- Detects plaintext ws://, missing Origin header validation (CSWSH), lack of authentication, missing limits, insecure broadcasts, XSS-over-WS, error leaks, and other key risks.
- Supports major WebSocket frameworks (ws, Socket.IO, FastAPI, Django Channels, gorilla/websocket, Spring WebSocket, ActionCable).
- CLI tool with zero external dependencies.
- No direct competitors on ClawHub.
